correctness.rationale: Every cell lies on exactly one row, column and symbol line. The equivariant line-cover nerve contains precisely the incident colored triangles; all missing colored triangles attach through rainbow 2-simplices. Hence the enlarged complex is equivariantly the three-fold join of discrete label sets, whose integral H2 is the tensor of augmentation lattices. One tetrahedron per intercalate attaches as the standard octahedral product-of-differences cycle; its stabilizer acts by even permutations. Coefficients on a chosen unique rainbow face per intercalate define an integral left inverse, proving injectivity and primitivity. The relative long exact sequence proves the theorem, with character additivity. Independently enumerated 312 signed autotopism traces on five Latin squares including a nongroup intercalate case, and exact mod-two nongroup Betti rank 60, agree.

value.rationale: Integral symmetry modules cannot in general be reconstructed from rational character or ordinary Betti numbers. This theorem gives a natural, universal exact presentation by label augmentation lattices, with canonical intercalate relations and full autotopism characters, providing explicit arithmetic and group-action structure for all Latin squares rather than a narrow artificial instance.
